correctness.rationale: For odd regular polygons the exact translated cone-volume formula reduces the p-measure to an average of f_p(t)=(R+t)^p(r-t)^(1-p) with zero-mean t_i. The p=1 case is exactly linear; for p>1, f_p''=p(p-1)(R+r)^2(R+t)^(p-2)(r-t)^(-p-1)>0, giving the sharp global bound and equality condition by Jensen. The log endpoint is the equal-weight average of the constant ratio R/r. The infinity endpoint follows from inradius/circumradius support bounds.

value.rationale: Regular polygons are the canonical finite rotational test family, while prior work explicitly treats endpoint coincidence as a structural problem for the p-measure hierarchy. The theorem gives an exact infinite family where every standard p-value collapses, adds the log endpoint, and identifies a sharp critical-set transition from all interior points at p=1 to a unique center for p>1. This supplies a useful benchmark for future calculations and equality classifications.
